howto.title: How to play
howto.0.title: Everyone in their own office
howto.0.text: Three to six colleagues, each alone in their own office. You can't see each other; the desk phone is your only line. At the end of the day, everyone meets around one table.
howto.1.title: The phone is everything
howto.1.text: Pick up the phone (Tab) and call a colleague. Only the two of you hear it — or so you think. Say whatever you like; nobody said it has to be true.
howto.2.title: Every round has one rule
howto.2.text: The Task app on your computer shows today's round. Read your private info, bargain on the phone, and submit before time runs out.
howto.3.title: Blame and Warnings
howto.3.text: Rounds hand out Blame, and everyone's blame is public. Every evening the meeting votes one person a Warning: extra blame and a mark on the record. One Warning per person per week; a tie means nobody gets one.
howto.4.title: Dirty tricks
howto.4.text: Once or twice a week you can pull a dirty trick: coffee on a keyboard, a pulled plug, dead Wi-Fi… You can also tip off the manager anonymously — but a false tip gets your name read out.
howto.5.title: This call may be recorded
howto.5.text: Calls may be recorded. At the meeting, the manager plays seven real seconds of somebody's call — be ready to hear your own voice. Nothing is saved to disk.
howto.6.title: Last day: someone gets fired
howto.6.text: The 2–3 colleagues with the most blame make the shortlist, each gets a defense, then a secret ballot: whoever gets the most votes is fired. Survivors score +3; your hidden-agenda target pays +1 per Warning and +2 if fired.
